rows.positive_scenario: Current members bind the exact normalized mesh resource
rows.negative_scenario: A nonmember and a member using another resource are rejected before ready
rows.expected_positive: agent-a and agent-b reach XMPP ready on resource Mesh-A
rows.expected_negative: agent-c/Mesh-A and agent-a/Mesh-A-other fail resource bind

rows.positive_scenario: Message, all IQ terminal/control forms, and directed presence use canonical full JIDs with equal exact mesh resources
rows.negative_scenario: Bare, cross-resource, foreign, presence subscription/probe, forwarded, carbon, MAM, and nested-stanza traffic never reaches the recipient or offline/archive retention
rows.expected_positive: same-resource message, Jingle IQ, terminal IQ, and directed presence are delivered and correlated
rows.expected_negative: recipient observes nothing during a bounded window and offline/MAM counts do not increase

rows.positive_scenario: Restricted admin mutation creates a group and adds members
rows.negative_scenario: An idempotent add does not change the current membership snapshot
rows.expected_positive: the current sorted membership snapshot changes only after a real mutation
rows.expected_negative: repeating add agent-a leaves the snapshot unchanged

rows.positive_scenario: Exact sessions page one immutable current-membership snapshot
rows.negative_scenario: A stalled pager cannot refresh its fixed deadline or retain aggregate authority capacity
rows.expected_positive: all pages exactly match the sorted current admin snapshot and another session succeeds after expiry
rows.expected_negative: the stalled unsynchronized exact resource is closed and its bounded member/byte allocation is released

rows.positive_scenario: Removing members atomically revokes their exact resources and invalidates every retained session snapshot
rows.negative_scenario: The removed identity cannot immediately bind the old mesh resource
rows.expected_positive: the snapshot contains only agent-b; removed exact resources disconnect while retained sessions cannot route until a fresh snapshot completes
rows.expected_negative: agent-a/Mesh-A bind is denied while membership is absent

rows.positive_scenario: Re-add permits a fresh authorized bind and complete current-membership snapshot
rows.negative_scenario: No bind is authorized while the identity is absent
rows.expected_positive: a re-added current member completes a fresh full snapshot before application traffic
rows.expected_negative: removed interval remains disconnected and unauthorized

rows.positive_scenario: A bounded ejabberd service restart preserves current membership
rows.negative_scenario: A restarted server does not admit the nonmember or alternate resource
rows.expected_positive: snapshot and same-resource routing remain exact
rows.expected_negative: negative bind and routing matrix remains enforced after restart

rows.negative_scenario: Teardown leaves no container, network, volume, private key, credential, or secret artifact
